Core Active Vocabulary (5 items):

discount — a reduction in price. Example: There is a discount of ten per cent.
sale — a period of lower prices. Example: The supermarket has a sale this week.
offer — a special lower price. Example: There is a special offer on apples.
kilo — one thousand grams. Example: A kilo of apples, please.
gram — a small unit of weight. Example: Two hundred grams of cheese, please.
Essential Chunks & Functional Collocations:

• It is on sale.
• There is a discount.
• A kilo of ..., please.
• Two hundred grams.
• It is a special offer.

Ask for quantities: a kilo of apples, two hundred grams of cheese. Talk about lower prices: It is on sale. There is a discount of ten per cent.
